Import preserves eligibility metadata and assigns eligible menus only to explicitly mapped branches
UAT-only idempotent BKK-01 reconciliation: preserve six imported menu IDs, add two approved menus, disable UI assortment assignments without deleting inventory/history
IndexedDB v2 invalidates disposable catalog snapshots only; pending outbox and sequence remain
Mobile grid min-width fix prevents horizontal page overflow with real recent orders
